parameters.query:
INSERT INTO legal_documents (
  law_name,
  law_number,
  language,
  category,
  source_url,
  source_file_name,
  document_hash,
  legal_status
)
VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  COALESCE(NULLIF($5, ''), 'manual-upload://' || $6),
  $6,
  encode(digest($7, 'sha256'), 'hex'),
  'active'
)
ON CONFLICT (source_url, document_hash)
DO UPDATE SET source_file_name = EXCLUDED.source_file_name
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO legal_chunks (
  document_id,
  chunk_index,
  chapter,
  section,
  subsection,
  content,
  embedding,
  metadata
)
VALUES (
  $1::uuid,
  $2::integer,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6,
  $7::vector,
  $8::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (document_id, chunk_index)
DO UPDATE SET
  chapter = EXCLUDED.chapter,
  section = EXCLUDED.section,
  subsection = EXCLUDED.subsection,
  content = EXCLUDED.content,
  embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding,
  metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata
RETURNING id, document_id, chunk_index;
